nodes.label: Layered Architecture (presentation / application / domain / infrastructure / shared)
nodes.norm_label: layered architecture (presentation / application / domain / infrastructure / shared)

nodes.label: Collection Repository
nodes.rationale: Interface defined in the domain layer (3A), implemented with local storage in the infrastructure layer (3B); supports save, get-all, get-by-ID, and duplicate-check by Discogs release ID.

nodes.label: Phase 3 Prompt 3A: Collection data model
nodes.rationale: Domain model and repository interface are defined before any storage or UI so later slices build on a stable contract; model carries both Discogs metadata and local-only fields (conditions, notes, tags, storage location, timestamps).

nodes.label: Phase 3 Prompt 3B: Local collection storage
nodes.rationale: Storage implementation lives in the infrastructure layer behind the domain-layer repository interface, kept out of widgets and testable; includes a duplicate check by Discogs release ID.

nodes.label: Phase 3 Prompt 3C: Add to collection use case
nodes.norm_label: phase 3 prompt 3c: add to collection use case
nodes.rationale: Use case converts release detail data into a CollectionItem with default empty local fields and timestamps, and prevents duplicates by Discogs release ID, returning a clear already-in-collection result.
nodes.source_file: docs/archive/prompts/used/phase3 - Prompt 3C: Add to collection use case.md

nodes.label: Phase 4 Prompt 4A: Wishlist data model
nodes.rationale: WishlistItem mirrors CollectionItem's Discogs metadata fields but swaps conditions/tags/storage-location for target price and a four-level priority (Low, Medium, High, Must have), reflecting want-list rather than ownership semantics.
